title: Jacky Chou's 10-year path from €450/mo intern to $500k/mo: SEO, dropshipping, partnerships
summary: Jacky walks through his timeline from a €450/mo Berlin internship in 2014 to about $500k/mo in revenue. It covers the Indexsy SEO agency, a dropshipping boom and bust, niche site flips, and the partnerships model that drove 2023 revenue. He also answers practical questions on partnerships and rank-and-rent.

principles.text: Keep a steady cash-flowing business alongside risky bets. The agency kept him afloat when dropshipping collapsed.
principles.quote: luckily indexi kept me afloat during this time um shout outs to indexi keeping the lights on

principles.text: Platform-dependent businesses can be wiped out by policy changes. Dropshipping hit Facebook bans and the iOS update.
principles.quote: we got clapped left and right by first Facebook uh updates being uh they were clapping really hard down hard on Drop Shipping sites

principles.text: Exit niche sites before Google algorithm updates hit them, and sell while they are still valuable.
principles.quote: 2023 happened a lot of my Niche sites got clapped to death by Google luckily I was able to exit a lot of them before um algo updates help happen

principles.text: Partnerships with established sites drove huge revenue. Focus on the agency, then find partnerships.
principles.quote: started focusing more on agency side then stumbled upon Partnerships and that drove huge amounts of Revenue into our business

principles.text: In a partnership, run affiliate accounts through your own tracking tag so you control the monetization.
principles.quote: you should set it up it should run through your account use your tracking tag add them as a website on your website list

principles.text: Value your time and buy cheap commodity work like citations instead of doing it manually.
principles.quote: it's five bucks I don't know if if you really don't have five bucks on for citations uh I don't I don't know what to do um I don't I value my time a bit more than that so I just buy the citations
